findings.title: Promised production_candidate boolean is absent from every current normalized recipe
findings.evidence: At review time all1608 shared/recipes.json rows lacked production_candidate, although handoff requires boolean and uses it to control label/method behavior. Outcast raw recipes already distinguish candidate and source-only records.
findings.required_change: Emit an explicit boolean on every shared recipe, preserve per-book false values, and validate false => game_label null and game_method_steps empty; true => concrete game ingredients and nonempty methods.
findings.recheck: Final12book output: all1753rows have boolean production_candidate. Every true row has nonempty ordered string methods; all29false rows have game_label=null and game_method_steps=[]. TAG/TRI302methods explicitly authored, source context/ingredients/IDs preserved, and repeatable helper is called by their builders.

findings.title: Pantry lookup needs its explicit join and normalization stage
findings.evidence: shared recipe IDs use book::local_id, but pantry recipe_dependencies.id uses book:book_recipe_id. Pantry also maps almonds->almond and barley malt->malted barley while shared recipe game_ingredients retain raw game terms. Literal exact-variant lookup described in handoff fails without that bridge.
findings.required_change: Document exact join on (shared.book_key, shared.local_id) == (pantry.book, pantry.book_recipe_id), or normalize pantry IDs. Prefer precomputed game_inputs.target_kind/target_id; when resolving from labels, apply the declared game_only_normalization_map and preserve book_term before local/shared/leaf lookup. This is explicit mapping, never fuzzy matching or source rewriting.
findings.recheck: Verified current handoff and related outputs implement requested change.

findings.title: Repeat existing interim boundary for offscreen and implied content
findings.evidence: Project setting_bible.md657–659 explicitly prohibits depiction and conservatively excludes new backstory, implied threats and offscreen events involving torture/deliberate child cruelty until treatment clarified. Shared docs mention only playable exclusion or unresolved offscreen treatment, weakening the practical handoff qualifier.
findings.required_change: State that user-confirmed boundary subjects remain distinct from unresolved treatment; until clarified, existing project interim guard excludes these subjects from new depiction, backstory, implied threats and offscreen events. Source research may retain critical context; no new user approval is needed for this review.
